decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: kickoff held [calendar:f1fc204e], first project reached day 1, and Rosa replied proactively stating intent to add the team [email:80e2806b]. Pro plan, active, no tickets, 8 days left. Stated intent plus momentum suggests better-than-even odds, tempered by no invite sent yet.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Glad to hear it's feeling good so far, and thanks for the update on getting the rest of the team added.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if it's a longer list. Seats can be added any time from Account Settings too.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through adding the team and getting everyone into your project.

Best,
Priya
